subject: Request: backfill SDE III (Platform) - headcount realignment & comp uplift
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@talentpartners.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: backfill SDE III (Platform) - headcount realignment & comp uplift

Team —

Following Rohan's departure from Platform last week, I'm requesting approval to backfill the open SDE III (Platform) headcount. Summary below and attached: SDE3-backfill-proposal.xlsx.

Why this is urgent:
- 40% of the current platform roadmap (inc. streaming KV cache improvements) depends on this slot.
- Hiring externally will take ~10–12 weeks; internal transfer reduces ramp and risk.

Proposal options (covered in attachment):
1) Internal transfer: move Maya Srinivasan (SWE II, infra) -> SDE III, immediate start, comp uplift request +1 band.
2) External hire: open req SDE III, hire at top of band; longer lead time and recruiting cost.

Budget ask: temporary uplift of up to 12% above current SDE3 midpoint for final offer if needed (benchmarked against market comp). Neha — I flagged the proposed numbers in the spreadsheet; would need comp committee sign-off. Markus/Laura — requesting headcount reallocation approval so we can initiate transfer conversations and update offers.

Attachments: SDE3-backfill-proposal.xlsx, org-chart-platform.pdf

Next steps I propose:
- Approve headcount reallocation and candidate pathway (internal vs external) by EOD Tue 11/24.
- If internal, Neha route to comp committee and Tara to run offer package.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Compensation Committee <comp-committee@vendors.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: backfill SDE III (Platform) - headcount realignment & comp uplift

Soojin —

Thanks for the summary and spreadsheet. A few quick asks before I take this to comp committee:
- Please include current salary, target uplift %, and the proposed final OTE (total on-target comp) in the workbook (right now the sheet shows midpoint adjustments but not full OTE).
- Provide a brief note on promotion justification if we move Maya up a band (impact, scope, performance signals).
- Confirm that we have the headcount capacity (finance sign-off) to repurpose this slot this quarter — I will need confirmation from Finance on the coding change.

If you can get those into the doc by Monday morning I can loop in Comp Committee and aim for a sign-off by Thu 11/26.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Compensation & Benefits
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: backfill SDE III (Platform) - headcount realignment & comp uplift

Soojin / Neha —

Quick note in support of considering Maya for the internal transfer: she has consistently exceeded on infra reliability OKRs this year and led the Kafka re-partitioning work with minimal oversight. I'm attaching Maya's perf summary and a small annotated org chart to show where the gap will be filled if we move her.

If we do promote internally I recommend a 1-band uplift with a clear 6-month impact plan and a merit-linked review at 6 months. This reduces recruiting cost and keeps institutional knowledge.

Attachment: maya_perf-summary.pdf

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Dir, Engineering Management
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Compensation Committee <comp-committee@vendors.com>, Tara Singh <tara@talentpartners.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: backfill SDE III (Platform) - headcount realignment & comp uplift

All —

I approve the headcount reallocation from the general SWE pool to Platform for this SDE III backfill, contingent on comp committee approval for the uplift request. Please route the package to comp-committee and include the exact offer numbers. Neha — can you confirm whether 12% uplift is within our current comp guardrails if we justify with retention risk?

Also cc-ing the comp committee to expedite — @comp-committee, flagged this as high priority for platform continuity.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Compensation Committee <comp-committee@vendors.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@talentpartners.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: backfill SDE III (Platform) - headcount realignment & comp uplift

Thanks everyone — updated the workbook with current salary and OTE scenarios (see SDE3-backfill-proposal.xlsx). I attached the comp committee note to summarize impact and retention rationale (comp-committee-note.docx).

If the committee approves the uplift I'll ask Tara to get an offer out to Maya with the uplifted band (internal-transfer pathway). If committee prefers no uplift, we'll proceed with external hire and reopen the req.

DocuSign link for formal approval (comp-committee): https://app.docusign.com/transactions/ABC123-approve-backfill

Next: Neha to confirm committee decision; Tara will prepare an internal transfer offer if approved; Laura and I will draft the 6-month impact plan for the promotion review.

Soojin
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SDE3-backfill-proposal.xlsx, comp-committee-note.docx, org-chart-platform.pdf
